name: Jeskai
description: The Jeskai are one of the five clans of Tarkir, a blue-red-white clan of monks, mystics and martial artists led by Narset.

bio.text: In the timeline where dragons survive, Ojutai took over the Jeskai by attacking the khans' meeting, accepted Shu Yun's surrender and had the ghostfire warriors executed.

status.text: The Jeskai are a reformed clan free of dragonlords and led in practice by Narset as waymaster, with its monks and skyriders defending Storm Crane.

citations.text: "Narset", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Jeskai are reorganized into a new clan headed by Ojutai and his brood.
timeline.quote: The Jeskai were reorganized into a new Clan headed by Ojutai and his brood

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ojutai takes over the Jeskai by attacking the khans' meeting and orders execution of every ghostfire warrior after Shu Yun's surrender.
timeline.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every Jeskai ghostfire warrior

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam, taught by Narset, leaves the Jeskai and travels to Purugir seeking work, drawing Sultai interest.
timeline.quote: He didn't set out to join another clan.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Jeskai monks kill the departing guard and burst into the ship to assassinate Taigam.
timeline.quote: Three human Jeskai monks stood with clenched fists.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ebirri fights the monks and kills two while Taigam, freeing himself, stabs the rakshasa, who then crushes a monk's head; Ebirri reminds Taigam he owns him.
timeline.quote: I own you,

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam learns that Narset sent the surviving monk, has the monk crushed, and suspects the monks were zealots acting without her.
timeline.quote: They were zealots, most likely acting without her knowledge.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam resolves to handle the Jeskai threat himself and has the dead monks sized for golden uniforms.
timeline.quote: Taigam signaled the sibsig to keep the boat moving as he began to size the intact dead monks for golden uniforms.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset meditates among a hundred monks in the plaza, outwardly serene while her mind races.
timeline.quote: But just because I look quiet and serene doesn't mean I am.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset ends the session by reciting a traditional saying that she privately dislikes.
timeline.quote: Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment,

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Without the naga's necromancy, the zombies disperse or crumble, and soldiers desert as Abzan and Jeskai raids grow.
timeline.quote: The months since had been one long slide into a perfect fulfillment of those prophetic words.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Ojutai declares through his aven translator that the Jeskai are no more, orders every ghostfire warrior killed, and commands Quan to erase the names of the clans.
timeline.quote: As of this day, there are no more clans. There are no more khans.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Ojutai accepts Shu Yun's surrender, has Jeskai ghostfire warriors executed, and rewrites Jeskai records.
timeline.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every ghostfire Jeskai warrior.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, scattered exiles flock to Narset, who declares they will defend Tarkir together.
timeline.quote: She took on the mantle of leadership and declared that they would defend Tarkir together.

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "Revival of the Jeskai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The invasion weakens Ojutai's forces, and hidden Jeskai archives spread, strengthening the rebellion.
timeline.quote: This shook the foundation of the dragonlord's power and allowed the rebellion to gain more traction.

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "Revival of the Jeskai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dives into the dragon's mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children.
timeline.quote: Elspeth dove headfirst into the open maw, sword held out like a beacon.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The wounded dragon flees to the deck and then off the ship while skyriders engage it.
timeline.quote: It began to writhe back, struggling to escape its attackers

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset tells Elspeth the Jeskai cannot help, then reveals she will go herself.
timeline.quote: But I can.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
timeline.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The Jeskai restore their lost archives from a draconic keeper.
timeline.quote: Wresting them from their draconic keeper proved much more challenging.

citation.text: Voracious Bibliophile (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Narset is appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai after the dragonlords' defeat.
timeline.quote: Narset was appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai.

citation.text: "Narset", section "The Stormnexus Ritual". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Through Narset's research, the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
timeline.quote: the clans were able to overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A hidden archive survives Ojutai's purge, preserving Shu Yun's writings and founding the reborn Jeskai Way.
timeline.quote: a hidden archive survived Ojutai ’s purge, preserving the ancient writings of Shu Yun

citation.text: "Cori Mountain Monastery", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the dragonlords fell Taigam joined the Jeskai while secretly plotting a revival of the dragons.
timeline.quote: secretly plotted a revival of the dragons

citation.text: "Taigam", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
